title: OMP Envelope
description: The common wrapper around every OMP message. Normative per the Core Schema Specification v0.1 section 2. Unknown envelope fields MUST be rejected.

omp_version.description: Semver of the core spec the message conforms to. Consumers MUST accept any same-major version.

profile.description: {profile_name}/{profile_major.minor}. The generic profile is always valid.

machine_id.description: Unique within the gateway. Stable across restarts and re-cabling.

seq.description: Per (gateway_id, machine_id) monotonically increasing, starting at 1, never reused, persisted across gateway restarts.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision, Z suffix. Event time as best known to the gateway.

schema.description: Which core schema the body conforms to.

body.description: Conforms to the schema named above plus the declared profile's constraints.

checksum.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of body.

sig.description: Optional base64 Ed25519 signature over gateway_id || machine_id || seq || checksum.
